verdict.rationale: LibreChat publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json and documents an Agent Management API (beta), which together form the raw basis for an API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer (Swagger/Redoc-style try-it console) or runnable examples. missing for 10: an interactive API explorer UI, runnable request examples, in-depth API reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
